# Data Structure

> Korean-language course materials from Pusan National University: lecture slides (PDF), interactive topic pages, and concept-check problem sets.

Instructor: [YongKyung Oh](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/people/yongkyung-oh/)

## Lectures

- [Course Goals and Structure](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/lecture/00.%20Course%20Goals%20and%20Structure.pdf) (PDF)
- [Abstract Data Types](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/lecture/01.%20Abstract%20Data%20Types.pdf) (PDF): [Data Abstraction](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/01.%20Data%20Abstraction/data-abstraction.html), [Operations and Semantics](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/01.%20Data%20Abstraction/operations-and-semantics.html), [ADT Specifications](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/01.%20Data%20Abstraction/adt-specifications.html), [Choosing an ADT](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/01.%20Data%20Abstraction/choosing-an-adt.html), [Concept check: Data Abstraction and ADTs](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/practice/data-abstraction-and-adts.html)
- [Data Structure Interfaces](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/lecture/02.%20Data%20Structure%20Interfaces.pdf) (PDF): [Interface and Specification](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/02.%20Interfaces/interface-and-specification.html), [Representation and Work](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/02.%20Interfaces/representation-and-work.html), [Python Objects](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/02.%20Interfaces/python-objects.html), [Two Implementations](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/02.%20Interfaces/two-implementations.html), [Concept check: Interfaces and Implementations](https://scientific-inference-lab.github.io/data-structure/practice/interfaces-and-implementations.html)
